context: Hiroshi-boss and Ren review a trade proposal.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business strategy; vocabulary (貿易/統一/承認/検証/提示) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 貿易の新しい案を、提示します。
lines.en: I'll present a new trade proposal.
lines.style: measured young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社内の承認は、取れそうかね?
lines.style: attentive boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 役員に提示し、承認を求めます。
lines.en: I'll present to the board and seek approval.
lines.style: confident young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 数字の検証は、済んでいるかね?
lines.style: thoughtful boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 何度も、検証を重ねました。
lines.en: I verified them many times over.
lines.style: reliable young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 取引の条件は、統一できるかね?
lines.en: Can we unify the trade terms?
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 条件の統一を、提案に含めました。
lines.en: I included term unification in the proposal.
lines.style: measured young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 検証を踏まえ、承認を出そう。
lines.en: Based on the verification, let's grant approval.
lines.style: warm boss voice, soft warm decisive closing throughout
